items.title: Snowman Adding a Tree-Top Star
items.alt: Snowman standing on a wooden stool and lifting a gold star above a small decorated Christmas tree.
items.description: The slim character stretches a twig arm toward the tree while balancing on the stool in a blue hat and red checked scarf.

items.title: Snowman Serving Two Cups of Cocoa
items.alt: Round snowman in a mustard cap and green apron carrying two cream cocoa cups on a wooden tray.
items.description: Closed smiling eyes and a carefully balanced tray make this a warm winter refreshment illustration.

items.title: Snowman Watching a Snowflake
items.alt: Small snowman with lavender earmuffs and a mint bow tie looking up at a snowflake above its carrot nose.
items.description: The oversized eyes, raised face and spread twig arms focus attention on the single delicate flake.

items.title: Snowman Knitting a Striped Scarf
items.alt: Seated snowman in a teal floral hat knitting a long coral and cream scarf beside a matching yarn ball.
items.description: Two wooden needles meet above the growing scarf, whose fringed end falls between the snowman's round feet.

items.title: Snowman Dancing with a Broom
items.alt: Cheerful snowman in a green waistcoat and brown top hat holding a straw broom with one snow foot lifted.
items.description: The broad smile, sweeping branch arm and jaunty stance turn a simple broom into a playful dance partner.

items.title: Snowman Stacking Christmas Gifts
items.alt: Snowman in a red earflap cap and blue neckerchief placing a green parcel on a stack of three gift boxes.
items.description: Both branch hands reach toward the smallest present above a blue snowflake box and a red striped package.
